description: Unexpected port congestion from labour disputes and vessel congestion caused 3-week container dwell times
root_cause: Labour action combined with vessel scheduling failures at Port of Singapore
lessons_learned: Need real-time port visibility; consider port insurance or cost-pass clauses; diversify ports
assumptions_wrong: Assumed port operates at 85-90% normal capacity; Actual: 50-60% capacity; Assumed 30-day lead times; Actual: 52-day dwell times

description: Defective component batch from new production line affected 2
started_at: Quality control gaps in supplier's new line; insufficient audits of expansion
assumptions_wrong: Tighten supplier quality audits; require redundant testing; add certification requirements
status: Assumed supplier ISO 9001 certification meant zero defects; Actual: 2.5% defect rate; Assumed suppliers maintain quality through expansion; Actual: new line had different standards

description: Peak season carrier capacity shortage led to rate hikes and spot market exposure
root_cause: Unexpected vessel breakdown cascade across carrier fleet during August peak
lessons_learned: Diversify carriers; negotiate long-term rate protection; activate backup carriers
assumptions_wrong: Assumed carriers maintain 15% capacity buffer year-round; Actual: no buffer during peak; Assumed current rates hold through Q4; Actual: rates tripled for 3 weeks
